documents_expected.why: call page: eligible recipients, costs, how to apply
the RFA (Word, on CPW's Widen file host, linked as 'Download the Application'): letters, W-9, insurance, reporting

eligibility.rule: Local governments, land agencies, tribes, conservation non-profits and private companies
eligibility.quote: Local governments, other state and federal land management agencies, tribes, non-profit habitat conservation organizations, and private companies.
Previous grant recipients with an active project that has fallen behind schedule relative to the project delivery timeframe identified in the application, and private landowners.

eligibility.rule: No active CPW project behind schedule
eligibility.quote: Previous grant recipients with an active project that has fallen behind schedule relative to the project delivery timeframe identified in the application

eligibility.rule: A Project Manager from the applicant's own organisation
eligibility.quote: The application must list a Project Manager. This person must be affiliated with the grant recipient's organization, and is the main point of contact for the project.
Each application must list a CPW Project Sponsor.

eligibility.rule: Not part of a mitigation project or bank
eligibility.quote: Any costs associated with wetlands that are part of a mitigation project or bank.
Project proponents who are unable or unwilling to show proof of liability insurance should not apply for Wetlands Program funding.

documents.item: Application form with maps and photos in one file
documents.quote: Include all maps and photos within the application; do not attach these separately.
Support letters are required from all landowners (private or public) whose properties are included within an application.

documents.item: IRS W-9 and proof of liability insurance (non-governmental)
documents.quote: All non-governmental grant recipients must provide an IRS W-9 form and proof of liability insurance (see Attachment 5).

effort.step: Contact the Wetlands Program Coordinator before applying
effort.quote: Please contact the Wetlands Program Coordinator before applying (see contact information below).

effort.step: Email the application to the coordinator as one PDF and Word file
effort.quote: Applications should be submitted electronically to the Wetlands Program Coordinator in a single file (both PDF and MS-Word formats) of less than 20MB.

co_finance_required.quote: Matching funds are not required but are encouraged and will be rewarded in the application review and selection process.

after_award.quote: Each calendar quarter (March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31) through project completion, the Project Manager must submit (electronically) a project update to the CPW Wetlands Program Coordinator, on the quarterly reporting form provided.

notes: Applications are closed; the next round is expected to open in February 2027, so no due date. The RFA is the 2025-26 cycle's (deadline 24 February 2026); a final report is also due. cpw.widen.net's robots.txt disallows crawlers, so the pipeline can't read the RFA and must not stamp (gold quotes from it were read by hand). Requests under $25,000 are discouraged.
